disposition: The engine IngestStream commits per-batch atomically across batches with bounded memory, create-only refusal without false success, unknown-commit abort, cancellation, and a typed refusal vocabulary — focused-tested. Gap: engine ingest seam only — no store-level BulkInsert writer, no metadata mutation during bulk, and no dynamic collection delegate; the P4 document.batch TBEP op is a bounded atomic multi-put, not a streaming bulk writer.
